title: Dale Keown
description: "STAR WARS has had a huge impact on me," reveals Dale Keown. "At the time of its release, I strapped a small tape recorder to my stomach, and taped the audio portion of the movie so I could take it home and listen to it while I flipped through the STAR WARS comic book adaptation." One of the most popular and critically-acclaimed artists in the comics biz, Keown's works include SAMURAI, FORCE (Aircel), Nth MAN and INCREDIBLE HULK (Marvel) and PITT for Image Comics.
